popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus' Attic stemma — Zeuxippe as wife of Pandion I and mother of Erechtheus, Butes, Procne and Philomela, the naiad hinge of Athens' early kings.

popCulture.title: Procne
popCulture.description: Procne and Philomela are Zeuxippe's daughters — the mother behind the nightingale tragedy that Ovid made famous.

popCulture.title: Pandion I
popCulture.description: Legendary king of Athens whose consort Zeuxippe bears the children who fill Attic myth — Erechtheus' generation and the Procne cycle.

popCulture.title: Zeuxippe
popCulture.description: Naiad wife of Pandion I — mother of Procne, Philomela and Erechtheus in the Attic royal stemma.
